# UC-373 — Define Domestic Shipping Zones and Store Fees

## Header Info
- **Use Case ID:** UC-373
- **Title:** Define Domestic Shipping Zones and Store Fees
- **Actor:** Vendor (ACT-02) — Owner of the own store
- **Trigger:** The Owner configures or replaces the store's shipping zones and per-zone fees
- **Priority:** P1
- **Goal:** Publish a domestic-only zone/fee schedule that checkout can resolve for every covered destination.
- **Preconditions:** Own store scope (BR-VND-07); store not suspended (BR-VND-04); v1 fulfils inside Yemen only (C-17).

## Main Scenario
1. Owner opens shipping settings → client `GET /store/shipping-zones` returns `zoneSlug`, `governorates`, `feeYER`, `freeOverYER` and `domesticOnly: true` (API-VND-010).
2. Owner edits the list → client `PUT /store/shipping-zones` with the full replacement configuration, Owner-only (API-VND-011).
3. Server rejects any zone outside domestic Yemen coverage with 422 `NO_SHIPPING_ZONE`; nothing is written (C-17).
4. On success the configuration feeds checkout: shipping fee = f(shipping zone, package weight, method), and is free when an applied coupon has type `free_shipping` (BR-SHP-01).
5. A buyer address with no covering zone fails checkout with `NO_SHIPPING_ZONE`, pointing the Owner back to this configuration.

## Alternative Scenarios
- **A1 — Free-over threshold:** the Owner sets `freeOverYER` so qualifying carts shipping from this store drop the fee (BR-SHP-01).
- **A2 — Replace semantics:** `PUT` replaces the whole list, so omitted zones are intentionally dropped rather than merged (API-VND-011).
- **A3 — Suspension overlay:** while suspended the write is refused and the stored schedule is preserved (BR-VND-04).

## Exception Scenarios
- **E1 — Zone outside domestic coverage:** → `NO_SHIPPING_ZONE`; the previous configuration stays intact (C-17).
- **E2 — Malformed fee:** non-integer or negative `feeYER` → `VALIDATION_ERROR`; nothing written.
- **E3 — Non-owner staff:** Editor/Manager attempting the write → `FORBIDDEN`; zone replacement is Owner-only (API-VND-011).
- **E4 — Buyer address uncovered later:** checkout rejects the session with `NO_SHIPPING_ZONE`; no order row is created (API-ORD-001).

## Postconditions
- Success: the full zone/fee list is replaced and `domesticOnly` remains true (C-17).
- Failure: the previously stored configuration is unchanged — no partial schedule.

## Business Rules Applied
- BR-SHP-01, BR-VND-04, BR-VND-07, BR-PLT-06

## Related Requirements
- FR-008 (Store Management & Storefront Configuration)
- FR-015 (Shipping & Delivery)

## Permissions / Data / External Dependencies
- **Permissions:** Owner only on the own store (API-VND-011); scope enforced server-side (BR-VND-07, SEC-REQ-004).
- **Data involved:** store shipping-zone rows (zoneSlug, governorates, feeYER, freeOverYER).
- **External dependencies:** checkout shipping resolution (B08); courier zone matching on assignment (BR-SHP-04).

## Acceptance Criteria
- **AC-UC373-01:** Given a valid zone list, when saved, then `GET /store/shipping-zones` returns it with `domesticOnly: true` (C-17).
- **AC-UC373-02:** Given a zone outside Yemen, when saved, then `NO_SHIPPING_ZONE` is returned and the configuration is unchanged (C-17).
- **AC-UC373-03:** Given a stored fee of 500 YER, when checkout resolves shipping, then that fee is applied (BR-SHP-01).
- **AC-UC373-04:** Given an applied `free_shipping` coupon, when checkout resolves shipping, then the fee is waived (BR-SHP-01).
